description: Version updates of the app: images of compose.yaml and the Dockerfiles, Python dependencies (uv.lock), the front's (web/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm itself), GitHub Actions and the shared workflow of llmops-platform (pinned to commit SHAs), pre-commit hooks.

packageRules.description: ruff: the Python package and the pre-commit hook on the same version
Python: the build and runtime stages of the Dockerfile, and .python-version, on the same version
Biome: the front's package, the pre-commit hook and the hook's copy on the same version
Node.js: the stages of web/Dockerfile and the CI's setup-node on the same version
The front's API client: the generator and its fetch client move together
Major versions need a reading of their upgrade notes

customManagers.description: The Biome of the pre-commit hook, an npm package Renovate's pre-commit manager does not read
